_README: Every real-world fact about the organisation lives here, in ONE place.
THE RULE THAT MATTERS: a value of null renders as NOTHING on the live
page. Not a blank line, not 'TBD', not '123 Anywhere St'. The whole block
is simply left out. That is deliberate. People in crisis may act on what
the CDC pages say, so a page must never show a phone number, an address,
a service or a programme that does not exist.
TO FILL ONE IN: replace null with the real value in quotes, commit, and
the block appears on the site by itself. Nothing else needs changing.
Each TODO below names exactly who has to supply the fact.

_README: A static website cannot receive a form submission by itself — there is
no server behind it to catch one. A form that posts nowhere is worse
than no form: a reader believes they have submitted something and they
have not.
So: while 'endpoint' is null, every form on the site renders with its
fields visible but SUBMISSION DISABLED, and says plainly that the
channel is not open yet. Nothing silently vanishes.
runbook/forms-setup.md explains how to switch them on. A form endpoint
URL is public by design and is NOT a secret — it is safe in this file.
An API key is NOT, and never goes here.
CRITICAL SAFETY RULES for everything under this key:
People in crisis may act on what a community development page says. A
programme listed here that does not exist, or a phone number that rings
nowhere, can do real harm to somebody who is already in trouble.
1. Never add a programme, service, phone number, address, statistic,
partner, eligibility rule or outcome that has not been confirmed.
2. NEVER publish a Zoom meeting ID, dial-in number or password here
or anywhere else on the site. Not once. The site uses a request
form instead. This applies to the His Presence Fire Thursday
service code, which must NOT be published.
3. Donate buttons stay disabled until a real payment processor exists.
